components._comment_movement: Speed is zero and there is no navigation or behaviour component anywhere in this file. The Watcher physically cannot walk; every position it has ever occupied was set by a teleport in an unobserved frame.
components._comment_physics: Gravity off so it cannot drift, settle or fall after placement. The script guarantees it is standing on something solid.
components._comment_inert: It cannot be hurt, cannot burn, cannot drown, and never makes a sound of its own. There is no aggro state to enter because there is no combat surface at all.
components._comment_lifecycle: Persistence is owned entirely by the script, which removes it only in frames where no player can see it.
